model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE
    dc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY
    dc.customer_segment_code
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(f.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
    ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_fees DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date
  ON fact_loan_delinquency_daily.business_date_key = dim_date.date_key
WHERE dim_date.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND fact_loan_delinquency_daily.days_past_due > 90

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
        ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
        ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM branch_atm_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    ft.currency_code,
    SUM(ft.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer ft
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON ft.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    ft.currency_code
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,
        business_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY business_id
            ORDER BY effective_from_date DESC, version_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE customer_key IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM ranked_customers
    WHERE rn > 1
);
